description: Type GitHub's refusal of an App JWT signed with a key it has not finished registering. For a few seconds after an App is created from a manifest, GitHub answers that App's JWT with the message "Integration must generate a public key", and the same request succeeds once the key has propagated. Alchemy's GitHub.AppInstallation retries these App-JWT operations on it. The status is not recorded there, so the matcher keys on the message alone.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: GitHub has not finished registering the App's private key, so it refuses the App's JWT. A freshly created App gets this for a few seconds; retry the request.

message.includes: Integration must generate a public key
